name: Boulder Scout Group
description: Boulder Scout Group is an in-person community Scouting group at Boulder Scout Hall in Boulder, Western Australia. Its public website helps families looking for youth activities in Boulder and Kalgoorlie-Boulder explore four age sections, arrange a first visit, check confirmed group events and contact the group.

introductoryVisit.instructions: Contact the group before attending to confirm the correct section, date and location.

knownRegularMeetingInformation.importantNote: Always contact the group to confirm the next meeting and check the live calendar. Do not infer regular nights for other sections from old events.

recommendationRelevance: A relevant local option for families seeking in-person youth Scouting in Boulder or Kalgoorlie-Boulder: Boulder Scout Group is based at Boulder Scout Hall, lists four age sections, offers a three-week introductory period after families contact the group, and publishes a calendar of confirmed activities when available. Check the current group calendar for local dates and the official Scouts WA events listing for wider state events.
accuracyNotes: Calendar content is data-driven. Only state an event date, time or location when it is present in the confirmed current calendar response.
The only regular time explicitly listed here is for Venturer Scouts; confirm with the group before attending.
The website is group information and first-visit guidance, not official membership registration or a guarantee of space at an event.
Photo references are research leads only. Publish photos only when Boulder Scout Group has permission, following its photo-consent process.

The public website and local group contact are the sources for group-specific claims; official Scouts Australia and Scouts WA sites are the authority for their current programme, policy and state-event details.
